resolved_findings.evidence: apps/console/src/routes/databases.tsx:124-125 looks up allocation solely by item.preparationId===preparation.id. Backend renewal now creates a new immutable preparation for the retained preparation.allocationId. Before that new preparation is admitted, the existing allocation still points at its old preparation, so the renewed card falsely offers Provisionner and has no Suspendre/Reprendre action. The backend correctly rejects provisioning a retained environment, while the old card's lifecycle uses stale revisions.
resolved_findings.refutation: Default local execution is unavailable, so the existing three browser journeys cover preparation and disabled provisioning rather than a qualified allocation. This does not resolve the source mismatch: once a qualified retained allocation is available, the console cannot reach the newly corrected fresh-preparation suspend/resume path.
resolved_findings.suggestion: Resolve retained allocation by its server-owned allocationId with released-state handling; ensure fresh preparation cards expose applicable suspend/resume and never offer a replacement provision for the retained instance.
resolved_findings.after_evidence: routes/databases.tsx:124 now resolves allocation.id === preparation.allocationId. Latest-preparation and exact current project/environment revision guards disable stale cards. Existing ready/suspended allocation exposes matching lifecycle action on its renewed preparation; retained/released allocations do not expose Provisionner. Old cards display an explicit renewal notice.

resolved_findings.evidence: project-management.tsx:48,63,72 and :188,207,219 combine uncontrolled defaultValue form fields with latest prop revisions on submit. projects.$projectId.tsx:76 keys metadata only by project.id; :127 leaves environment forms mounted under unchanged environment.id. A same-ID background refetch after another metadata write refreshes expectedRevision but leaves stale live input values, allowing those stale values to overwrite the newer server version without REVISION_CONFLICT.
resolved_findings.refutation: Normal edits followed by reload work, and the backend enforces exact revisions correctly. The failing interleaving is narrower: a query refresh updates the submit closure's revision while uncontrolled inputs retain the earlier draft. Existing persisted-edit journeys do not exercise a concurrent background update.
resolved_findings.suggestion: Capture draft and base revision together, or explicitly remount/reset forms on relevant revision changes; keep success and pending state aligned with that same form version.
resolved_findings.after_evidence: Final correction: ProjectMetadataForm inner form key is project.revision; EnvironmentMetadataForm inner form key is environment.revision+project.revision; RepositoryForm inner form key is project.revision. Component keys remain stable by project/environment identity, so useMutation confirmation persists through query refresh while keyed DOM fields reset to the matching saved revision. Repository fields are named uncontrolled defaultValue/defaultChecked inputs; onSubmit constructs FormData, validates RepositoryConfiguration and pairs that form body with project.revision. Exact scope remains /projects/{project.id}/repository.
